title: Crypto Privacy Risk Calculator - Assess Your Blockchain Anonymity
metaDescription: Calculate your cryptocurrency privacy risk score. Assess blockchain anonymity threats from exchange KYC, chain analysis, and transaction patterns.
description: Evaluate your cryptocurrency privacy risks with our comprehensive calculator. Assess threats from blockchain analysis, exchange tracking, wallet types, and transaction patterns to understand your anonymity level and get personalized recommendations.

formula: const cryptoRisk = {bitcoin: 60, ethereum: 70, monero: 5, zcash: 15, litecoin: 65, 'other-transparent': 65, 'other-private': 20}[primaryCrypto]; const walletRisk = {'exchange-custodial': 40, 'software-hot': 25, hardware: 15, 'privacy-focused': 5, multisig: 10}[walletType]; const kycRisk = {never: 0, minimal: 10, regular: 30, exclusive: 50}[exchangeKyc]; const freqRisk = Math.min(transactionFrequency * 0.5, 20); const privacyBonus = {none: 0, basic: -5, intermediate: -15, advanced: -25, expert: -35}[privacyTechniques]; const addressRisk = {always: 25, sometimes: 15, rarely: 5, never: 0}[addressReuse]; const publicRisk = publicActivity ? 15: 0; const baseScore = cryptoRisk + walletRisk + kycRisk + freqRisk + privacyBonus + addressRisk + publicRisk; const privacyScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseScore)); const trackingVulnerability = privacyScore; const riskLevel = privacyScore <= 20 ? 'A': privacyScore <= 40 ? 'B': privacyScore <= 60 ? 'C': privacyScore <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; return {privacyScore, riskLevel, trackingVulnerability};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates cryptocurrency privacy risks by analyzing blockchain transparency, wallet security, exchange usage patterns, and privacy techniques. The scoring system weighs factors like cryptocurrency type (privacy coins score lower), wallet types (hardware and privacy wallets reduce risk), KYC exchange usage (increases traceability), transaction frequency (more transactions create larger patterns), privacy techniques used (mixing and Tor reduce scores), and address reuse patterns (reuse increases linkability).
tips: Use privacy coins like Monero or Zcash for enhanced transaction anonymity
Avoid reusing wallet addresses - generate new ones for each transaction
Consider using privacy-focused wallets like Samourai or Wasabi for Bitcoin
Use Tor browser or VPN when accessing crypto services to hide your IP
Minimize KYC exchange usage and consider decentralized exchanges when possible

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
